overview.Name: CID HoldCo, Inc.
overview.Description: CID HoldCo, Inc. develops an asset tracking platform that push the limits of near real-time precision-based location technology. The company's platform leverages the technologies, including the patented passive and active RFID tracking solutions, low power edge camera platforms utilizing artificial intelligence, enabling users to give accuracy to all mapping technologies. It serves various industries, including construction, military, mining, retail, warehousing, and manufacturing. The company is headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada.
